patch_description: Adds a translationally shared nearest-neighbour IsingZZ sweep directly after the fixed Möbius-ladder entangler. The new shared correlation angle contributes only one additional circuit parameter while allowing the model to continuously tune local pair correlations that the fixed CZ network cannot adapt. Collective RY/RZ rotations remain tied to preserve strong few-shot regularization, and the ansatz is assembled from reusable graph definitions for clarity and maintainability.
